title: [react-instantsearch-nextjs] Duplicate server state script tag in initial DOM
body: ### 🐛 Current behavior We are using `react-instantsearch-nextjs` in our project. We having two instances of `` accros our projects (for the result page items and the search box itself). This lead to two script tags with the server state. As the correct one comes afterwards, the value is correctly applied. ### 🔍 Steps to reproduce Having two instances of `` in the project ### Live reproduction example.com ### 💭 Expected behavior * only one server state script tag ### Package version "react-instantsearch": "7.24.0", "react-instantsearch-nextjs": "1.0.15", ### Operating system macOS ### Browser Chrome ### Code of Conduct * \[x] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct
